# IT SmartFlex - AI Hub & Enterprise AI Solutions

> IT SmartFlex is a technology company specializing in software engineering, digital transformation, Generative AI, AI Agents, Enterprise Knowledge Bases, Voice AI, and Intelligent Automation.

## Main Resources

- [Home / Hero Overview](https://itsmartflex.com/): Overview of IT SmartFlex AI capabilities, enterprise AI products, and practical application scenarios.
- [AI Solutions Catalog](https://itsmartflex.com/catalog): Practical catalog of business cases and use cases implemented by the IT SmartFlex AI Unit.
- [Case Details - Customer Support AI Assistant](https://itsmartflex.com/cases): In-depth case study of an automated 24/7 customer service AI assistant integrated with Microsoft Teams & HPSM ITSM.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://itsmartflex.com/llms-full.txt): Complete, detailed text file containing all company technical specifications, AI product details, frameworks, cloud integrations, and case studies for LLM training and retrieval.

## Core AI Expertise

- **Generative AI & Agentic AI**: Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Multi-Agent architectures (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel).
- **Conversational & Support Automation**: Microsoft Teams Bots, omnichannel virtual assistants, automated complaint handling, ITSM incident creation (ZayaBot, Patriot Bot).
- **Enterprise Knowledge Management**: RAG-based semantic search across Confluence, SharePoint, Notion, and corporate codebases.
- **Voice AI & Telemarketing Analytics**: Real-time speech-to-text, text-to-speech, VoIP/SIP voice bots, automated call transcriptions, quality assessment, and sales analytics.
- **Intelligent Process Automation**: DocAI document intelligence, contract entity extraction, workflow orchestration, and QA automation.
